audit.whatIsWrong: Chart read Skill x6 then Sejuani, which disagrees with the already-audited mirror (sejuani__nautilus): Nautilus, Nautilus, Nautilus, Skill, Sejuani, Skill, Skill.
audit.why: Mirror is authoritative and matches the kits — Nautilus' passive root wins levels 1-3 autos, Glacial Prison takes level 6, and two immobile tanks even out with items.
audit.corrected: Rows set to Nautilus, Nautilus, Nautilus, Skill, Sejuani, Skill, Skill on both layers with ratings to match.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spike text at 2+ items claimed Nautilus' kit becomes 'redundant peel'; and the level-6 spike called Glacial Prison zero-counterplay versus Depth Charge.
audit.why: Depth Charge is point-click at 825 and cannot be dodged; Glacial Prison is a 1300-range bola projectile that stuns only the first champion hit.
audit.corrected: Level 6 favours Sejuani on range and area, but the late spike is even utility, not redundancy.

audit.whatIsWrong: Text repeatedly calls the stun 'her permafrost passive' and 'permafrost shatter'. Permafrost is her E; her passive is Fury of the North. Her ultimate was called a 'point-blank AOE stun' when it is a 1300-range bola.
audit.why: Riot text: Permafrost (E, 560 range, 1.5s, 20 mana) stuns a champion at maximum Frost stacks; Frost is applied by Winter's Wrath (W, 9/8/7/6/5s). Fury of the North grants Frost Armor with slow immunity out of combat and shatters stunned enemies for damage.
audit.corrected: Frost Armor's slow immunity means your E slow and Iceborn chains do not stick to a fresh out-of-combat Sejuani; the tracked cooldown is Arctic Assault (Q, 18/16.5/15/13.5/12s, 650), her only gap-closer.

edits.after: Neither of you has engage online, but your passive root wins the auto-trade outright; Frost Armor only grants her slow immunity, not damage, so level 1 is yours.

edits.after: Your W shield and splash burn win the short trade; Permafrost (E) only stuns at maximum Frost stacks, so burst her before Winter's Wrath stacks them on you.

edits.before: Her stun after Frost stacks. Don't get stacked + stunned. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Permafrost (E) is a 1.5s stun at max Frost — the real window is Arctic Assault, down 12-18s once she charges.

edits.before: Two tanks staring at each other, and you actually have the better Level 1-3: your passive root plus Q-pull lets you win short autos before she has anything online. The catch is she does not care — her permafrost passive stacks on you every time you trade, and the moment it shatters (her E, or a jungler tag) you eat a free stun. So trade in quick bursts: Q-pull, land your passive root and W splash burn, then E-slow and walk out before she stacks frost on you. Do not sit in extended autos; that is her game, not yours.
edits.after: Two tanks staring at each other, and you actually have the better Level 1-3: your passive root plus Dredge Line wins short autos before she has anything online. The catch is Winter's Wrath stacks Frost on you every trade, and at maximum stacks her Permafrost (E) stuns for 20 mana on a 1.5-second cooldown. So trade in quick bursts: Q-pull, land your passive root and W splash burn, then E-slow and walk out before those stacks land. Do not sit in extended autos; that is her game, not yours.

edits.before: This is where it tips against you. Her E only needs a couple of stacks to become a hard stun, and her W is chunking a percent of your max HP every cast — which means the tank items you want to buy literally make her trades hit harder. At 6 her ult out-ranges and out-reliably-lands yours: your Depth Charge is single-target, hers is a wide AOE point-blank stun she can flash-engage with. You can still threaten a Q-pull all-in if she mispositions, but trade-for-trade you are now losing the damage race and the CC race.
edits.after: This is where it tips against you. Permafrost needs only maximum Frost stacks to hard-stun, and Winter's Wrath applies them every cast on a 5-9 second cooldown, while Frost Armor shrugs your E slow off a Sejuani who has been out of combat. At 6 her Glacial Prison is a 1300-range bola that stuns the first champion hit and storms the rest, out-ranging your 825 Depth Charge — though yours is point-click and undodgeable. Threaten a Dredge Line all-in whenever Arctic Assault is down its 12-18 seconds.
